claims.claim: The delivered diff (ASMHELPER-WALK-GUARD.diff) adds a scoped RAII guard around exactly that innermost read: covering-page math (16-KiB pages, PAGE_SHIFT 14, 1-2 pages per <=16-byte read) -> labeled old-prot (registered current-map cover provider, else checkpoint constant 0x4) -> skip if already readable (nesting-safe) -> else single inline-syscall-74 mprotect(range, PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC = 0x5) -> read -> restore old prot; transition rc!=0 => loud throw with ZERO reads (C-7); restore rc!=0 => loud ANOMALY + permanent refusal latch (never a dtor throw, ladder-stop without UB); guard fold OFF (define absent or 0) => loud refusal + throw with the transition code preprocessor-DEAD (zero syscall text, the R9 property). Initializer call sites remain byte-identical to the frozen staging unit (sha c85c42f7...).

claims.claim: Verdict dependency (D2 fold): the guard's build define RC_ASM_WALK_RX_GUARD=1 is admissible ONLY for rows whose IGW verdict shows seq5 rx_result.mprotect_rc==0, i.e. W_WORKS and W_FAILS_R_WORKS (matrix rows R1/R2/R3/R4 - R3/R4 explicitly need 'per-page RX for walks'). BOTH_FAIL, FATAL and ABSENT compile with the define ABSENT: the wrapper then refuses loudly at the helper layer (the no-exec gate's throw policy) with zero syscalls. Because the runtime ALSO fail-closes on rc!=0 even when folded ON, a mis-folded verdict degrades to the loud refusal, never to a silent crash.
claims.evidence: LAUNCH10-MATRIX section 0 D2 table + rule 4 and section 2 rows R1-R5/R9; EXEC-WRITABILITY-PROBE-DESIGN section 5 seq5 gate + C-7; NO-EXEC-GATE-DESIGN section 2.2 loud-failure policy. Full mapping table in WALK-GUARD-DESIGN.md section 4.
